messages:
mira.s: Heads-up: Were cutting over org SSO for GitHub and migrating the Jira project keys to the new identity domain next Tuesday 02:00-04:00 UTC. This affects web sign-in, API tokens, and some CI integrations. Migration runbook: https://go.internal/sso-github-jira-cutover (please read)

leo.sec: Quick note: API tokens bound to old SSO sessions will be invalidated. We'll try not to break service accounts, but rotate any long-lived tokens beforehand.

anna.devex: Which teams need to opt in / test? Any automation to help repos and workflows?

mira.s: Everyone with org repos + Jira admins. Dev teams: check webhook deliveries and Actions that use repo-scoped tokens. We added an automation script `scripts/migrate-gh-jira.sh` in the migration repo to update webhook callbacks and regenerate app tokens for installed apps in a dry-run mode.

dmitri.sre: What about CI runners that use GitHub App installations or PATs stored in secret manager?

leo.sec: Runners using GitHub Apps should be fine; Apps will be re-installed automatically via the migration tool. PATs stored in Secret Manager pointing to individual users will need rotation. Service accounts using org-level OAuth should be migrated to new org service principals (mapping in the doc).

github-bot: Reminder: run pre-checks with `./preflight.sh --org redwood --check-webhooks --check-apps`

anna.devex: Can we get a test org and Jira sandbox to validate? I'd like to run a test migration for 2 sample repos.

mira.s: Test org: `redwood-ops-staging`. Jira sandbox: `ops-sandbox`. Use `--dry-run` flag. Please report results by Mon 18:00 UTC.

dmitri.sre: Rollout plan? How do we detect failures and rollback?

mira.s: Canary approach: migrate 10% of repos (low-traffic) -> 50% -> remainder. If webhooks or actions fail >1% above baseline, we halt and roll back to legacy SSO routing for 30m while we patch. Rollback commands are in the runbook. We'll have on-call SRE + security in the loop.

jira-migrate-bot: Canary start scheduled: -00:30 UTC. Gates: webhook_success_rate >= 99.5%, action_runs_success >= 99%.

leo.sec: Security checklist: rotate user PATs flagged by the secrets scanner, ensure service principals have least privilege, confirm SAML attributes mapping for group sync.

anna.devex: I'll publish a migration checklist to repo-owners and link templates for updating workflows. Also will schedule a 30-min office hours Tue 09:00 UTC.

mira.s: Monitoring to watch: `github.webhook.latency`, `github.webhook.errors`, `jira.webhook.errors`, plus CI failure rate. Alerts: P1 pager, P2 slack channel #eng-platform.

dmitri.sre: I'll stand by on-call during the window and watch the dashboards. Ping me in thread for immediate attention.

mira.s: Action items recap:
- Dev teams: run preflight in staging and fix webhooks/workflows
- Repo owners: accept app re-install invites and review token mappings
- CI owners: rotate user PATs and migrate runner configs if needed
- Security: audit service principals and secrets before cutover

anna.devex: Noted. Will post the checklist and the office-hours invite.

mira.s: Thanks everyone. Post blockers here; tagging @leo.sec and @dmitri.sre for readiness checks. :thumbsup:
